children.text: At SAIS - Abu Dhabi, we recognize that proper nutrition is the cornerstone of student well-being and academic success. Our “Food and Nutrition” program is designed to nourish young minds and bodies, fostering healthy habits that support growth, concentration, and lifelong wellness.

heading.title:
Growing Strong Minds Through
Good Nutrition

image.alt: SAIS - Abu Dhabi kindergarten students smiling and waving

children.text: Our canteen operates from two separate dining halls; one for boys and one for girls to ensure comfort and privacy for all students. Each hall provides:
Nutritious, Balanced Meals
Carefully planned hot entrées featuring fresh fruits, vegetables, whole grains, and lean proteins. Menus rotate regularly to introduce variety and meet the dietary needs of different age groups.
Approved Light Snacks & Beverages
A selection of wholesome snacks and thirst-quenching drinks, all vetted against our strict nutrition guidelines.
Efficient Service During Breaks
Friendly, timely service during morning and afternoon breaks keeps students energized and ready to learn.

image.alt: SAIS - Abu Dhabi teacher leading an activity with young students

children.text: Daily Sanitation:
Complete cleaning and disinfecting of dining areas, serving stations, and kitchen equipment after each meal period.
Strict Personal Hygiene:
Canteen staff follow rigorous hand-washing protocols, wear protective attire, and undergo regular health screenings.

image.alt: SAIS - Abu Dhabi kindergarten student on the playground slide

children.text: All members of the canteen staff hold valid certifications from the Abu Dhabi Municipality and the Ministry of Health. They participate in ongoing training on food safety, nutritional standards, and customer care to ensure every meal meets the highest quality and safety benchmarks.

By integrating balanced nutrition with impeccable hygiene practices, our Food and Nutrition page underscores the pivotal role our canteen plays in promoting a healthy, positive school experience for every student.

children.text: At Sharjah American International School – Abu Dhabi Campus (SAIS - Abu Dhabi), the health and safety comprehensive on-site medical service staffed by:
A licensed doctor
Three qualified registered nurses
Three fully equipped clinics strategically located across campus

image.alt: SAIS - Abu Dhabi kindergarten students playing on ride-on toys

children.text: Whether class is in session or during extracurricular activities, our medical team provides:
Routine health screenings, vaccinations, and check-ups
Immediate first-aid and treatment for sports-related injuries
Management of acute illnesses and chronic conditions
Coordination of specialist referrals and follow-up care

Each clinic also serves as a hub for preventive health education; offering age-appropriate workshops and one-on-one guidance on balanced nutrition, personal hygiene, stress management, and injury prevention.

By embedding these services directly within the school environment, SAIS - Abu Dhabi fosters close, trusting relationships between students and healthcare professionals. This hands-on, holistic approach not only promotes better health outcomes but also supports every student’s emotional well-being and academic success.

children.text: Inclusion is not just a policy, it’s a core value that defines our educational philosophy.

We are committed to creating a welcoming, respectful, and supportive environment where every student, including students of determination (students with special needs), is embraced, empowered, and actively included in the learning journey.

heading.title: Building a Culture of Inclusion & Belonging

image.alt: SAIS - Abu Dhabi student reading outdoors

cards.description: We implement a comprehensive Learning Support Program focused on improving literacy and numeracy skills for students who need additional academic assistance. Through Individualized Education Plans (IEPs) and differentiated instruction, we ensure that learning is tailored to suit each child’s needs, interests, and pace.
cards.title: Personalized Support Programs

cards.description: Our dedicated learning support teachers and specialists in children’s well-being work hand-in-hand with classroom teachers to provide targeted interventions and emotional support. Continuous professional development ensures that our educators are equipped with inclusive teaching strategies that foster success for all learners.
cards.title: Skilled and Caring Educators

cards.description: We follow a multi-tiered system of support, where students’ progress is regularly monitored, and interventions become more intensive based on the level of need. This ensures early identification and continuous growth for every learner.
cards.title: Multi-Tiered Intervention Model

cards.description: Students of determination are not separated, they learn alongside their peers in mainstream classrooms, contributing to and benefiting from shared experiences. This builds empathy, acceptance, and a sense of community.
cards.title: Inclusive Classrooms

cards.description: Our inclusive practices are fully aligned with the UAE’s National Policy for Empowering People of Determination. We believe that all students have the right to quality education and meaningful participation, regardless of ability.
cards.title: Aligned with UAE National Policy

children.text: We see each student as an individual with unique potential. We go beyond just accommodating students of determination, we empower them. Inclusion here means every voice matters, every effort is celebrated, and every student belongs.

children.text: We understand that a safe, reliable journey to and from school is essential for both students’ peace of mind and parents’ confidence. Our school transportation service is designed to deliver the highest standards of comfort, security, and efficiency.

image.alt: SAIS - Abu Dhabi students running on the school track

children.text: Modern, Well-Maintained Fleet:
All vehicles undergo daily inspections and routine maintenance to ensure peak performance and reliability.
Qualified Drivers & Escorts:
Each bus is operated by a licensed driver with extensive experience in student transport, assisted by a trained attendant who supervises boarding and disembarking.
Safe Pick-Up & Drop-Off Points:
We establish designated stops throughout Abu Dhabi and surrounding neighborhoods, each supervised by school staff to guarantee orderly and secure transitions.
Strict Safety Protocols:

From mandatory seat belts to regular vehicle sanitization, our protocols comply with all UAE health and safety regulations. We conduct regular emergency drills to ensure students and staff are prepared for any situation.

image.alt: SAIS - Abu Dhabi school reception lobby

children.text: To register your child for our transportation service or to learn more about available routes and fees, please:

E: saisq@saisuaq.com
(please include “Transportation” in the subject line)
We’re here to answer your questions and customize a route that best supports your family’s needs.

SAIS - Abu Dhabi isn’t just a school. It’s a place where students feel at home. Within our diverse and supportive community, every child is valued, every voice is heard, and every success is celebrated. Here, learning is a shared journey, and growth happens together, like a family.
